title: Physical road loading detail
caption: All used physical links are shown, excluding virtual turn arcs. Points retain the saved PCE, v/c and BPR segment travel time. The OUT-state convention omits the first physical link when loading a path; the figure does not alter that endpoint convention. Single-pass engineering scenario; no local empirical calibration.
transformation: Keep physical rows with saved volume_pce > 1e-9; display two scatter relationships. Statistics are outside the axis labels.

Canonical SVG presentation-only transform: append an explicit DejaVu Serif, Georgia, Times New Roman, serif fallback rule for text and tspan with !important; no font binaries, geometry, numeric labels, PNG pixels or source SVG bytes changed.
source_record_sanitization: Original evidence retained in private snapshot; derived record contains logical IDs and SHA-256 only.
